sloka: मानुषौ तौ न शक्नोषि हन्तुम् वै राम लक्ष्मणौ ।निःसत्त्वस्य अल्प वीर्यस्य वासः ते कीदृशः तु इह ॥३-२१-१९॥
transliteration: mānuṣau tau na śaknoṣi hantum vai rāma lakṣmaṇau ।niḥsattvasya alpa vīryasya vāsaḥ te kīdṛśaḥ tu iha ॥3-21-19॥

translations.english: You have little strength and less heroism. You with your relations should immediately leave Janasthana. What kind of position do you have here?
